text:
maria: Quick sync — Zetta asked for final perf/W numbers and a kernel patch schedule for the joint run. We need a handoff doc + who owns which metric.

alex: I can own throughput and batch scaling curves. I'll run the 8/16 batch sweep on Ampere racks today. ETA 4h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

hiro_zetta: Thanks. We'll push the kernel patch to our test build after Alex's first pass. Plan: compare perf/W and 99th latency across seq 512/2048.

anna: From PM side, marketing wants a short blurb about expected gains (high level) by EOD tomorrow for the marketplace page. Can we get a confidence interval?

alex: For now I can say ~15-22% perf/W improvement with the quantized kernel on our internally measured runs, but will confirm after today's sweep.

zeta_eng: We also want to capture memory footprint and KV cache hit rates. Suggest adding a small telemetry hook.

maria: Good call. @zeta_eng can you add the hook to the run script? Keep it opt-in. Also, please add the exact git sha of the kernel patch.

zeta_eng: Yep. I'll attach the patch sha in the results JSON.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: ampere-test-pool scheduled for disruption at 1801239000 (maintenance window)

alex: Heads up — ops window overlaps with our runs. I'll prioritize a single-node sweep to get baseline before the window.

hiro_zetta: We'll mirror that. If you can paste the command you run, we'll replicate on our side.

alex: Command I used:
```
./run_throughput.sh --model llama-70b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --quantize q4_0 --telemetry on --output results/algo-v1.json
```

hiro_zetta: Got it — will run same and report numbers.

anna: Also assign ownership: Maria (coordinator), Alex (throughput), Hiro (partner-side validation), Zeta (kernel hook), Anna (marketing copy). Agree?

maria: Agreed. I'll create a short Handoff doc in the partnership drive and paste link here when done. :white_check_mark:

zeta_eng: FYI, if we show perf/W improvements >20% we need to include the exact hardware config (fans, p-state). I'll note that in results.

maria: Perfect. Reminder — don't share raw logs externally until we sync with legal.

alex: Will redact IPs before sharing.

hiro_zetta: Uploading results in 3–4h.

maria: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the drive link and next steps. :rocket:
